# Keep both release-update verification kinds on the same archive boundary

Entry 2079 changes last-linux-bz2-version from 134.0b4 to 134.99.0 in both release-update-verify-config and release-update-verify-config-next. Fixed accepted source retains equal values. When changing this boundary, inspect both task kinds and the consuming version comparison; do not leave the next-release configuration on the old value. This source observation does not prove archive availability, a successful generated update config, the comparison semantics or an update run. The upstream port and review context remain pending.

Scope: Taskcluster release update verification configuration.
